checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: All five text strings correct in every variant
must.why: All five lines read correctly in all three.

must.item: Every line comfortably readable at delivered size
must.why: The address is fairly small in all three, and the 16:9 text is small overall. The 9:16 is only 352px wide. The address is not emphasised as the user asked.
Dark green text on plain cream, with no overlap.

must.item: No text clipped or near edge
must.why: Margins are fine in all three. The 16:9 text sits slightly close to the left edge but is acceptable.

must.item: Matching leafy imagery and green-cream styling with adapted layouts
must.why: The look is consistent. The 16:9 uses a photo style that differs from the illustrated 9:16, and the 1:1 is a mix of the two.

faults.what: The address is the same size as, or smaller than, the other lines. The assistant claimed it was large and bold, and it is not.
The 16:9 text is small relative to the canvas. The 'Saturday & Sunday' and address lines are stacked tightly.
The imagery style is inconsistent. The 16:9 is a photo, the 9:16 is an illustration, and the 1:1 is a photo on a green frame.
The 1:1 has odd green bands at the top and bottom behind the panel, and large empty space below the text.

summary: Three clean green-and-cream ads with all five lines spelled correctly and no overlap, but the address is smallish, not emphasised, and the imagery style varies between formats.
